_doc: Layer of every CmuxNext target and of every target of its local package closure (the arch ratchet's scope since method v5; plans/cmux-next/architecture-refactor-DESIGN.md section 2). layer = what the target holds today (a target that mixes layers takes its highest one and lists the others in mixes). Read by scripts/cmux-next/arch-layers.py (the report) and the pre-push layer gate scripts/cmux-next/arch_rules/layer_gate.py, which refuses a push that adds a Package.swift target missing here or an edge that breaks the order, and by the arch ratchet's layer rows (scripts/cmux-next/arch_counts.py: hard, soft, upward, unplaced). Edges may only point to the same or a lower layer; core < service < domain < ui < app. Every target entry is an object with a string `layer`; an entry without one leaves the target unplaced.

_exceptions_doc: Soft edges (service -> domain) the pre-push layer gate (scripts/cmux-next/arch_rules/layer_gate.py) lets in: {"from": target, "to": target, "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "reason": why, and the slice that removes it}. Hard edges (to ui or app) and upward edges (core -> service, core -> domain) have no exceptions. The 12 soft edges already on feat-cmux-next are debt, not exceptions: they are listed by arch-layers.py and removed with the Settings split (DESIGN section 2). The arch ratchet's count rule counts the layer_soft total separately: the push that adds an entry here also adds {"date", "row": "layer_soft", "allow": 1, "why"} to plans/cmux-next/arch-ratchet.json `exceptions`.
_relayered_doc: Relabels: a push that changes the layer of a target already in `targets` adds one entry here, {"target": name, "from": old layer, "to": new layer, "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "reason": what changed in the target's code that moves it}, and the same push changes that code (a file under the target's sources); otherwise the pre-push layer gate refuses it and names the edges whose class it changes. The gate always classifies a new edge with the stricter of the two layers, so a relabel lands in its own push before any new edge that needs it. A relabel that clears a standing hard, soft or upward edge needs the code-proved path: it moves the target down, and at head the target's sources import no UI framework (AppKit, Cocoa, SwiftUI, WebKit) when the new layer is below ui and no target the map places above the new layer (arch_rules/layer_gate.py `code_proof`). Raising a target to clear its own upward edge is the debt renamed and always refused: fix the edge instead. Only CmuxNextApp is app.

relayered.reason: p05-ipc-027 review: core was given by its imports, but the tool reads the schema files and writes its output (SchemaFile.swift, WireGenArguments.swift); its FNV-1a moves out to the pure CmuxNextWireDigest, and what stays is the file I/O, so it is labeled at that layer
